explanation: Map each word to its most recent index. Each repeated occurrence yields the nearest repetition ending there, so update the minimum gap and replace its saved index.
timeComplexity: O(S+n) expected time including hashing for n words containing S characters.
spaceComplexity: O(S) stored key characters and O(u) map entries for u distinct words.
